title_options: Ollama Prompt Cache Misses: Check the First Changing Line
Local Agent Slow After Turn One? Check the First Changed Prompt Line
Find the Prompt Line That Breaks Ollama's Cache Reuse
presentation.title_rationale: The reader arrives with a symptom - a local Ollama agent that is fast on the first turn and slow later - and no cached-token counter on this build. The selected title frontloads the product (Ollama), names the mechanism the article measured (prompt cache misses) and gives one supported action: inspect the first line that changes, which is exactly the diagnostic the body proves with two recorded turns (962 tokens / 2.4711 s vs 993 tokens / 36.8326 s). It promises no speedup, no setting and no Ollama-wide claim, and at 57 characters it drops the 98-character original's method clause and trailing year. The two alternatives lead with the symptom or with the action instead of the product.
presentation.visual_purpose: The diagram explains the one concept the article turns on - prefix reuse is bounded by where the prompt stops matching - as a three-step reading order: Stable prefix, then First changed line, then Reuse boundary, under the caption 'Inspect changes near the beginning of the prompt.' Scope: conceptual only, matching the body's prefix-divergence explanation (Ollama 0.20.3 observation, not an engine-source citation); it carries no seconds, token counts or per-arm ratio, so nothing in it can be mistaken for a measurement.
